a
Every tagged object has been inspected.
b
Every inspected object has a tag.
c
At least one tagged object has been inspected.
d
There is a tagged object that has never been inspected.
e
No object is both tagged and inspected.
f
Some inspected object lacks a tag.
g
All objects either have a tag or have been inspected, possibly both.
h
It is false that all objects are tagged.
i
If anything is tagged, then something has been inspected; the two objects may differ.
j
Every object has both a tag and an inspection.
k
At least one object is neither tagged nor inspected.
l
Tagged objects are exactly the inspected objects.
